name: Fire Spread Tweaks

vanilla_changes.change: Sets doFireTick to false on first world load so fire does not spread; fires burn out after about 10-20 s (default 300 ticks +/- 100 random). Trees and other flammables may burn briefly but are not destroyed. Fire above netherrack, magma or soul sand stays lit.

editor_notes: Defaults per Modrinth: timeFireBurnsInTicks 300, random extra -100..+100. No pack config override seen in config-overrides. doFireTick is only set on first world load, so existing worlds may differ.
summary: Stops fire from spreading and destroying blocks, while making fires actually burn out after a delay. Fire on netherrack, magma blocks and soul sand still burns forever.
